component_cases.heading: SEQUENCE OF OPERATION VAV TERMINAL UNIT (NON-FAN POWERED):
component_cases.text: 1. EACH VAV TERMINAL UNIT WILL BE PROVIDED WITH A BACNET COMPATIBLE TERMINAL EQUIPMENT CONTROLLER (TEC), A DUAL TECHNOLOGY OCCUPANCY SENSOR, A DOWNSTREAM STATIC PRESSURE SENSOR, AND A PRIMARY MODULATING SUPPLY AIR DAMPER.
component_cases.constraint: Each applies only after a VAV equipment set is established. Dual technology describes one sensor, not two devices or two channels. A damper requirement does not separately establish actuator quantity, torque, power or signal. No activity owner, physical terminal type or installed quantity follows from this paragraph. This source case remains pending parser/workflow implementation.

Preserve separate source occurrence identities and require explicit applicability; do not merge component roles by equal text, or multiply either paragraph by every scheduled DOAS.
